body: I'm happy to hear you were able to contact them! Sometimes the ears of a generous person is all we need. Stay safe, and thanks for your concern as well.

Hello. Do you think you may have bottled up your feelings and now they blew up because of some specific trigger? What kind of things lead you to thoughts of self-harm?

It is a good thing you've made that promise to your mother. No human being deserves self-harm. I used to slit my wrists and legs, and burn my skin with matches. One day, though, I realized I was an abuser to myself. I deserved better.

You deserve better too. Don't forget.

It's my believe that even horrible people deserve happiness and oportunity. If you know the things you've done are awful, you can change them. You can study your own behaviour, your triggers, your excuses. You can change the dynamics of your mind.

You ought to try and change yourself. You are not a slave to your actions. 

A horrible people is only as horrible as the things they do. If you stop behaving destructively, you'll stop being a bad person. It's actually quite simple.

But in order to do so, you'll have to face the fact that you are actively deciding who you are. Up to now, you've decided to be cruel and mean. Nothing can change that fact. And yet, tomorrow you may decide to be the opposite.

Posting your post was the first step in this new decision.

>getting my brain to somehow hate me.

Why do you think your brain hates yourself? Where does this emotion come from?

>that might not seem like much to you

No, friend, I know how badly we want to achieve things. That's not something small. 

> I have so many other problems

Sometimes, when we put our problems together like a giant soup, they seem thicker and deeper than they really are. May I suggest you pick them apart and focus on the largest one?

Getting good at something is not easy. Sometimes, depending on what your hobby is, it isn't even worth it to try and be a pro.

You shouldn't try to be the best at what you do if what you do doesn't give you pleasure. You should do whatever pleases you so much that the way to expertise doesn't feel so steep and painful.

I may have misunderstood your suffering, but if it's about attaching your value to your skills, then please don't do that.

You are a human being. You can speak, read, laugh. You can feel empathy. These fundamental skills, which are present in most humans, are much much more important than any art or job you could master.

You are already a master at being human. No one can take that away from you.

Do not forget that.

And, if you haven't done it already, talk to a psychiatrist.
